newsitem.title: GREECE: EUROMONEY CONFERENCE ON GREECE SET FOR JUNE 12-13.
newsitem.headline: EUROMONEY CONFERENCE ON GREECE SET FOR JUNE 12-13.

text.p: A Euromoney conference on Greece's role in international and regional markets will take place in Athens June 12-13 and include speeches by Bank of Greece governor Lucas Papademos and National Bank governor Theodore Karatzas.
The conference will address such issues as the implications of the euro for Greece and how the country can harness the benefits of EU membership and its regional links, Euromoney said.

Other speakers will include HSBC Investment Bank chief executive Keith Harris, Athens bourse president Manolis Xanthakis, capital market commission president Stavros Thomadakis and Jason Stratos, president of the Federation of Greek Industries.
The conference will be held at the Athenaeum Intercontinental hotel. --George Georgiopoulos, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
